== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns William Anderson. The banns/marriage index records Agnas Glasgow and William Anderson on 5 July 1666 at Longformacus.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 750/10 / 79; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
